messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported large p95/p99 regressions since ~09:40 UTC. Affected: Dedicated pool eu-west-2-prod-d-42. Posting preliminary metrics and starting triage.

devon: Confirming. Provisioning queue depth spiked to ~180 and attach latencies > 8s for many requests. Autoscaler did not add capacity fast enough; saw a bunch of 'attach_rate_limited' errors in attach-controller logs.

ashley: Support opened INC-12374 with the customer. They hit timeouts and some 502s. Customer ran a short burst test (~600 RPS) which seems to reproduce. They've asked for ETA and workaround.

liam: Quick repro script (k6) I used to simulate:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'x'.repeat(100)}), { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer $TOKEN' } });
  sleep(0.02);
}
```
Ran 2k virtual users for 3m and saw attach queue backpressure.

maria: Reproduced in staging. Root signals: node image pulls got serialized (registry throttle + large kernel image), attach-controller backoff policy too conservative for this burst, and many requests missed prefix cache causing extra token work once attached.

devon: Immediate mitigations applied: 1) temporary pool capacity bump (+3 GPUs to eu-west-2-prod-d-42) — rolled out at 10:05 UTC, 2) enabled hosted fallback routing for affected org ids (customer opt-in) so critical traffic goes to hosted nodes, 3) canaryed increasing attach_parallelism from 2->6 in pool-controller, 4) kicked off pre-pull job for kernel images on spare nodes.

ashley: Customer notified about the fallback and capacity bump. They've acknowledged and will monitor; asked for ETA on durable fix.

liam: Logs + error snippets I collected:
```
attach-controller: attach_rate_limited org=acct_ABC reason=attach_queue_full queue_len=142
kubelet: image pull backoff: reason=registry-429
runtime: cold_gpu_attach_time=124.8s
```
Also saw a spike in cache-miss ratio for common prefixes.

maria: Created follow-ups: PLAT-3215 (randomized attach backoff + jitter), PLAT-3216 (image pre-pull orchestration + cache), OBS-2100 (new alarm: attach_queue_len > 50 p95). Assigning PLAT-3215 -> devon, PLAT-3216 -> liam.

sre-bot: Canary deploy: pool-controller attach_parallelism=6 rolled to 3 nodes in eu-west-2 at 10:22 UTC.

devon: Longer-term recommendations: add probe-based warmup for anticipated campaigns, incorporate image pull readiness into autoscaler decision, and tune autoscaler ramp thresholds for short, high-amplitude bursts. Also add deterministic burst load to perf CI so we catch regression in e2e before deploy.

support-ops: Thanks team — fallback + bump bought enough time. Customer says latency is back to acceptable range for now. Will keep INC open until PLAT tickets land.

maria: Next steps: postmortem if INC remains critical after 24h, finish the PLAT tickets, and add a runbook for similar campaign surges (pre-warm + fallback gating).
